018package org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc;
019
020import static java.lang.String.format;
021import static org.apiguardian.api.API.Status.STABLE;
022
023import javax.lang.model.element.Element;
024import java.util.List;
025
026import org.apiguardian.api.API;
027import org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.CustomTagletBase;
028import org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.foundation.annotation.ClassVersion;
029import com.sun.source.doctree.DocTree;
030
031/**
032 *  <p>{@summary This taglet is used to refer to the author of the
033 *  modifications for a piece of code that was originally written by somebody
034 *  else (named in the {@code @author} or the
035 * {@link AuthorTaglet @extauthor}
036 * tag).} It requires that reference to the editor in the format below:</p>
037 *  <pre><code>  &#x40;modified &lt;<i>name</i>&gt; <b>-</b> &lt;<i>email address</i>&gt;</code></pre>
038 *  <p>Basically, this is the name of the editor, followed by their email
039 *  address, separated by a hyphen (&quot;&#x2d;&quot; &amp;#x2d), surrounded
040 *  by blanks.</p>
041 *  <p>If there is no email address, just the name will be shown in the
042 *  output.</p>
043 *
044 *  @author Thomas Thrien - thomas.thrien@tquadrat.org
045 *  @version $Id: ModifiedTaglet.java 1282 2026-09-08 23:52:53Z tquadrat $
046 *  @since 0.0.5
047 */
048@ClassVersion( sourceVersion = "$Id: ModifiedTaglet.java 1282 2026-09-08 23:52:53Z tquadrat $" )
049@API( status = STABLE, since = "0.0.5" )
050public final class ModifiedTaglet extends CustomTagletBase
051{
052        /*-----------*\
053    ====** Constants **========================================================
054        \*-----------*/
055    /**
056     *  <p>{@summary The name of this taglet: {@value}.}</p>
057     */
058    public static final String TAGLET_NAME = "modified";
059
060        /*--------------*\
061    ====** Constructors **=====================================================
062        \*--------------*/
063    /**
064     *  <p>{@summary Creates a new {@code ModifiedTaglet} instance.}</p>
065     */
066    public ModifiedTaglet()
067    {
068        super( TAGLET_NAME, false, Location.values() );
069    }   //  ModifiedTaglet()
070
071        /*---------*\
072    ====** Methods **==========================================================
073        \*---------*/
074    /**
075     *  {@inheritDoc}
076     */
077    @Override
078    public final String toString( final List<? extends DocTree> tags, final Element element )
079    {
080        final var template =
081            """
082            
083            <dt><span class="simpleTagLabel">Modified by:</span></dt>
084              <dd>%s</dd>
085            """;
086        final var retValue = format( template, parseNameAndEmail( tags ) );
087
088        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
089        return retValue;
090    }   //  toString()
091}
092//  class ModifiedTaglet
093
094/*
095 *  End of File
